meta.description: Kiezruf: report problems in your neighbourhood on the spot and back them with “Me too”.
nav.label: Main navigation
signin.title: Sign in
signin.intro: You do not need an account to look around. To report, comment, follow or vote “Me too”, sign in with your email address. The same account works in the app.
signin.privacy: We will send you a 6-digit code. Your email address is never shown publicly.
signin.codeSent: We sent a code to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
browse.title: Reports in Berlin
browse.empty: There are no reports here that match the filters.
filters.label: Filters
map.label: Map
map.listAlternative: The list contains the same reports as the map.
map.failed: The map could not be loaded. The list shows all reports.
meToo.hint: “Me too” only counts on the spot. Your browser will ask for your location.
detail.label: Report
detail.title: Report
detail.pickBody: Choose a report in the list or on the map to see photos, status and comments.
detail.notFoundBody: This report does not exist or is not public yet.
comments.flagged: Thanks, we will review this comment.
comments.held: Your comment is held for review before it appears.
notLive.title: Kiezruf is not live here yet
notLive.body: No office takes reports through Kiezruf at this place yet.
notLive.bodyNamed: {tenant} does not take reports through Kiezruf yet.
notLive.notifyMe: Tell me when it starts here
notLive.subscribed: We will email you as soon as Kiezruf starts here.
compose.title: Report a problem
compose.intro: Reports are made on the spot. You see the receiving office before you post.
compose.onSiteNote: Photos without location and time in their file are saved as a draft in this browser only. Finish them in the app when you are back on site.
compose.locationHint: Your browser will ask for your precise location now. It is used for this report only.
compose.accuracyAdvice: Wait a moment or step outside, then try again. An accuracy of {max} m or better is needed.
compose.photosHint: 1 to {max} photos. Only photos with location and capture time in the file, taken in the last {hours} hours.
compose.draftExplain: At least one photo does not meet the on-site rules. Remove it, or save the report as a draft in this browser.
photos.tooMany: At most {max} photos per report. Further photos were not added.
photo.reason.no_metadata: Location or capture time is missing from the file: draft only.
photo.reason.capture_in_future: The capture time is in the future: draft only.
photo.reason.unsupported_type: This file type is not supported (JPEG, PNG or HEIC).
emergency.title: In an emergency, call right away:
emergency.note: Kiezruf is not an emergency service. Reports are not read around the clock.
pin.atCapture: The pin is at your location.
pin.moved: The pin is {distance} from your location (at most {max} m).
review.missingIntro: Before posting, this is still missing:
review.missingLive: a place where Kiezruf is live
review.photoDraftOnly: photos that meet the on-site rules (step 2)
posted.title: Report posted
posted.processing: Faces and number plates are being blurred now. After that the report appears on the map.
posted.following: You follow the report automatically and hear about every status change.
drafts.title: Drafts in this browser
drafts.explain: Drafts stay in this browser only. You cannot post them from here; take new photos on the spot.
drafts.saved: Saved as a draft in this browser.
myReports.title: My reports
myReports.signInWhy: Sign in to see your reports.
myReports.empty: You have not reported anything yet.
myReports.notPublicYet: Not public yet: faces and number plates are being blurred or the report is being reviewed.
myReports.rejectedNote: This report was rejected and is not public.
following.title: Followed reports
following.intro: We notify you about every status change of these reports.
following.signInWhy: Sign in to see the reports you follow.
following.empty: You do not follow any report yet.
account.title: Account
account.signInWhy: Sign in to manage your account.
account.notificationsExplain: On the web we notify you by email. Phone notifications are set in the app.
account.emailStatusChange: Status changes of reports I follow
account.emailGoLive: Kiezruf starting in places I asked about
account.deleteExplain: Your account is deleted at once. Public reports and comments stay and then show “a neighbour”. Your email address is removed within 30 days.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out on every device.
account.deleted: Your account is deleted. You are signed out.
